factual_claims.claim: AB KN Energies reported improved consolidated results for the nine months ended 30 September 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income shows higher revenue (76,664 vs 67,977) and profit figures for 2025 vs 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The principal growth driver was LNG terminal activity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Notes to Financial Statements (Section 4 Operating Segments) highlight LNGT as a key segment with significant revenue growth.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue from LNGT services increased to EUR 43.640 million from EUR 31.401 million, supported by higher regasification volumes, customer bonuses for booked capacity, and the fact that the terminal had been out of operation for one and a half months for dry-dock repairs in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 states: 'Revenue from LNGT services during the nine months of 2025 is higher... due to: (i) the terminal being out of operation for one and a half months in 2024... (ii) higher LNG regasification volumes and (iii) bonuses paid by LNGT clients for booked capacity.'

factual_claims.claim: These gains were partly offset by lower income from other LNG terminal activities and a EUR 2.753 million reduction related to repayment of excess returns from regulated activities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 footnote (3) explains: 'The decrease in revenue was affected by... reduction of LNG security supplement income in 2025 due to proportionally recognised repayment of the excess returns... In 2024 the security supplement was 0 EUR/(MWh/day/year).' The amount matches the EUR 2.753 million figure.

factual_claims.claim: Segment net profit increased in LET and LNGT activities, but declined in commercial LNG activities to EUR 2.411 million from EUR 3.948 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment data in Notes (Section 4) shows LET net profit increased, LNGT increased, and comLNG decreased from 3,948 to 2,411.

factual_claims.claim: Following the acquisition of the floating storage and regasification unit in December 2024, EUR 11.369 million of related depreciation was recorded in this category in 2025 rather than as right-of-use depreciation.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 14 states: 'Following the acquisition of the FSRU on 6 December 2024... for the 9 months of 2025, EUR 11,369 thousand of the FSRU depreciation expenses were recognised under “Depreciation and amortisation...” In previous periods, these expenses were accounted as the “Depreciation of right-of-use assets.”'

factual_claims.claim: In the third quarter alone, revenue was nearly unchanged at EUR 25.581 million, but net profit declined to EUR 4.570 million from EUR 10.403 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income shows Group revenue for 7-9 months 2025: 25,581 vs 25,363 (2024); net profit: 4,570 vs 10,403 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow rose to EUR 76.331 million from EUR 35.637 million, partly reflecting the reclassification of EUR 31.900 million of financial assets to cash and cash equivalents.
